# Authorized provider logos

Place only logo assets that you are authorized to display here.

Recommended naming:
- bajaj-general.svg
- hdfc-ergo.svg
- icici-lombard.svg
- tata-aig.svg

Do not copy random Google Images or imply a partnership that you do not have.
The UI supports a logo per provider through `VITE_AUTHORIZED_PROVIDERS_JSON`.
